MikroTik RB5009UG+S+IN – High-Performance Gigabit Router for Advanced Networking

Powerful & Compact Router for Home and Business Networks

The MikroTik RB5009UG+S+IN is a high-performance, compact, and feature-rich Ethernet router, designed to handle demanding networking tasks with efficiency. Powered by a Marvell Armada ARMv8 4-core 1.4GHz CPU, 1GB DDR4 RAM, and 1GB NAND storage, this router delivers exceptional speed and stability for both home and enterprise environments.


With seven (7) Gigabit LAN ports, one (1) high-speed 2.5GbE LAN port, and one (1) SFP+ port (10Gbps fiber connectivity), the RB5009UG+S+IN provides ultra-fast data transfers, making it ideal for ISP networks, data centers, and advanced networking setups.


Key Features 

  • Powerful ARMv8 Quad-Core Processor – Marvell Armada 1.4GHz (4-core) CPU ensures fast and reliable processing power.
  • Next-Generation Connectivity – Equipped with seven (7) Gigabit LAN ports, one (1) 2.5Gbit LAN port, and one (1) SFP+ (10G) fiber port for blazing-fast networking.
  • RouterOS L5 License – Enables advanced routing, firewall protection, VLAN, VPN support, and network management features.
  • High-Performance Memory & Storage – 1GB DDR4 RAM for fast data processing and 1GB NAND storage for system stability.
  • Robust Metal Desktop Case – Durable and heat-resistant metal enclosure ensures long-lasting performance.
  • Multiple Power Options – Supports DC power input, PoE-in (802.3af/at), and a 2-pin power adapter for flexible deployment.
  • Fanless & Silent Operation – Efficient passive cooling for quiet and reliable performance.
  • Compact Yet Powerful – Space-saving desktop form factor with high-end networking capabilities.
  • Made in Europe – Manufactured by MikroTik in Latvia or Lithuania, ensuring top-tier quality and reliability.
  • 12-Month Limited Warranty – Peace of mind with one-year manufacturer warranty.


Technical Specifications

  • Brand: MikroTik
  • Model: RB5009UG+S+IN
  • CPU: Marvell Armada ARMv8 (Quad-Core, 1.4GHz per core)
  • RAM: 1GB DDR4
  • Storage: 1GB NAND
  • Ethernet Ports: 7 x 1GbE LAN + 1 x 2.5GbE LAN
  • SFP+ Port: 1 x 10Gbps Fiber Port
  • Power Options: PoE-In (802.3af/at), DC Jack, 2-Pin Power Adapter
  • Operating System: RouterOS L5 License
  • Cooling: Fanless Passive Cooling
  • Enclosure: Metal Desktop Case
  • Manufacturing Origin: Latvia or Lithuania
  • Warranty: 12-Month Limited Warranty

Ideal Applications

  • ISP & Enterprise Networks – Designed for high-bandwidth and multi-user environments.
  • Data Centers & Cloud Networking – Supports fast data transfer and virtualization.
  • Fiber & High-Speed Internet Deployment – 10Gbps SFP+ and 2.5GbE LAN for ultra-fast connections.
  • Advanced Home Networking – Future-proof multi-gigabit home network setup.
  • Secure VPN & Firewall Protection – Ensures robust security with RouterOS L5 advanced features.


Why Choose MikroTik RB5009UG+S+IN?

  • Ultra-Fast Networking – Multi-gigabit connectivity for high-speed data transfer.
  • Enterprise-Grade Performance – Ideal for business, ISPs, and high-demand networks.
  • Flexible Power Options – Supports PoE, DC, and power adapter inputs.
  • Durable & Reliable – Metal case, passive cooling, and high-end hardware.
